seo__browser_title: Need Help Now? | Oakdene House Foundation
seo__search_description: If you need support right now, help is available. Crisis lines, emergency contacts, and Oakdene House contact details.
hero__intro: You are not alone. Help is available 24 hours a day.
emergency__text: If you are in immediate danger
crisis_helplines__intro: These services are available around the clock, any day of the year.
talk_to_oakdene__text: If you need to speak with someone at Oakdene during business hours, please call us directly. We can help connect you with the right support.
talk_to_oakdene__text_3: We also offer support in multiple languages. If you need an interpreter, please let us know when you call.
talk_to_oakdene__text_4: Our team is available Monday to Friday during business hours.
talk_to_oakdene__text_5: For outside-hours support please use the crisis lines listed on this page.
final_note__text: Oakdene House is not a crisis line. For immediate emergencies always call **000**. For 24-hour crisis support, please use the helplines above.
